source: due2-native: an absolute deadline with no timezone (decisions/0024, #116)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. Without a timezone, whether the deadline has passed is undecided at every instant within 14 hours of it (due2-profiles.md §4), so near its deadline the duty's status would be unknown for want of a well-formed policy, not for want of data.

expected_rejection.why: ex:pay's dprod:deadline "2026-06-02T00:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime has no timezone. An absolute deadline is an xsd:dateTime with a timezone (due2-profiles.md §7, decisions/0024), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2.
